description: A tiny animated status mark. Six tells, five states, one 0.8s beat.

values.drones: A squad of four drones running drills, keen and prone to pile-ups. Their shadows are the floor.
values.flipdot: A 5×5 flip-disc board, like the ones on old bus signs. Every disc clacks over and wobbles before it settles. All business.
values.eyes: Two eyes on a dark visor, and the most human of the six. The eyes dart first, the head catches up, and every mood morphs into the next.
values.blot: A drop of cartoon liquid that reaches, drips, splats, and pulls itself back together, with real gravity and generous squash and stretch.
values.dekatron: A 1950s counting tube. One glow hops around a ring of ten. Precise and steady, right up until it jams.
values.lens: One calm, watchful eye behind smoky glass in a metal bezel. The iris does all the talking.

attributes.name: state
attributes.description: What the tell is reporting. Changing it plays a handoff into the new state.

values.current: The surrounding text color, including inside other components' slots.

values.auto: Reads the color-scheme around the tell.
values.invert: The opposite of the color-scheme around the tell.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Accessible name. Defaults to the state. Set it to an empty string when nearby text already says the state.

events.name: tell-dance
events.description: Fires before a tell dances. Call preventDefault() to keep it still.

events.name: tell-after-dance
events.description: Fires when a dance ends, or when a state or skin change cuts it short.

statics.name: timeScale
statics.description: Experimental. Multiplies every tell’s clock: 1 is normal, 0.5 is half speed, 2 is double. 0, a negative, or anything that isn’t a number stops them.

cssProperties.name: --tell-size
cssProperties.description: Width and height. Tuned for 20 to 48px.

cssProperties.name: --tell-color-working
cssProperties.description: Working color. Any CSS color, including light-dark().

cssProperties.name: --tell-color-done
cssProperties.description: Done color. Any CSS color, including light-dark().

cssProperties.name: --tell-color-error
cssProperties.description: Error color. Any CSS color, including light-dark().

cssProperties.name: --tell-color-warning
cssProperties.description: Warning color. Any CSS color, including light-dark().

cssProperties.name: --tell-color-idle
cssProperties.description: Idle color. Any CSS color, including light-dark().
